title: AiConnectionsList
description: server -> device, the reply to list_ai_connections. ok: true carries the claiming account's AI connections — the same list the server returns on its account connections page. ok: false carries an error: "not_claimed" when no account has claimed this phone.

client_id.description: The third-party client's id — what revoke_ai_connection carries as connection_id.

display_name.description: Account-editable override if set, else a default derived from the client type (e.g. "Claude" / "ChatGPT" / "Custom").

image_url.description: Account-editable override, else null (no default image is assigned).

connected_at.description: ISO 8601 — when the grant backing this connection was first created.

last_used_at.description: ISO 8601, or null if never used since it was connected.
